methodology.notes: All 50 airline base tasks were evaluated four times: 200 conversations, 168 passes and 32 failures. No task or failed trial was excluded. Customer simulator: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B. This is a custom evaluation. Prior evaluations on this benchmark informed development; this is not a held-out result. Submitted transcripts contain marked privacy redactions and anonymized metadata. All task/trial outcomes and recorded rewards are retained.

verification.details: All 50 airline base tasks and four trials per task are included. Transcripts are privacy-edited; scores reflect the original recorded outcomes.
